description: Several colorful translucent magnetic tiles—mostly squares and triangles—are spread out on the tabletop in front of the hands. The right hand picks up a green square and stands it upright against an orange square while the left hand steadies pieces nearby, then the right hand adds a yellow square and the left hand slides a gray square into place to form a small open cube; next, the right hand gathers triangle tiles, and both hands lift and angle them together to assemble a pyramid roof that they press onto the cube, creating a little house shape.
